def stop_line(stderr: str) -> str | None:
    """The root cause when a component reported one (transport, verifier, publisher), else the driver's last FAIL line."""
    lines = [line.strip() for line in stderr.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    causes = [line for line in lines if re.search(r"ci-hosted-transport: |hosted-gate-verify: FAIL|ci-git-publication: ", line)]
    if causes:
        return causes[0]
    wanted = [line for line in lines if "ci-gate-canary: FAIL" in line]
    return (wanted or lines or [None])[-1]


def apply_patch(clone: Path, patch: dict) -> None:
    path = clone / DRIVER_REL
    text = path.read_text()
    count = text.count(patch["old"])
    if count != 1:
        raise DryRunError(f"reintroduction patch {patch.get('name')!r} applies {count} times, not exactly once")
    path.write_text(text.replace(patch["old"], patch["new"]))


def prepare_clone(args, work: Path) -> dict:
    clone = work / "clone"
    run(["git", "clone", "-q", "--shared", "--no-checkout", str(ROOT), str(clone)])
    head = git(ROOT, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    git(clone, "checkout", "-q", "-B", "dry-run", head)
    for key, value in (("user.name", "Phase 253 dry run"), ("user.email", "dry-run@example.invalid"), ("commit.gpgsign", "false")):
        git(clone, "config", key, value)
    changed = False
    if args.overlay_worktree:
        # Development and test aid: carry the real checkout's uncommitted scripts/ci edits into the clone (read-only use
        # of the real checkout). The summary lists every overlaid path; the default run tests HEAD exactly.
        listed = git(ROOT, "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD", "--", "scripts/ci").splitlines()
        listed += git(ROOT, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "--", "scripts/ci").splitlines()
        overlaid = sorted({rel for rel in listed if rel and "__pycache__" not in rel})
        for rel in overlaid:
            source, target = ROOT / rel, clone / rel
            if source.exists():
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copy2(source, target)
                git(clone, "add", rel)
            else:
                git(clone, "rm", "-q", rel)
        args.overlaid = overlaid
        changed = bool(overlaid)
    if args.driver_from:
        content = run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "show", f"{args.driver_from}:{DRIVER_REL}"]).stdout
        (clone / DRIVER_REL).write_bytes(content)
        changed = True
    if args.driver_patch:
        apply_patch(clone, json.loads(Path(args.driver_patch).read_text()))
        changed = True
    if getattr(args, "transport_from", None):
        # 253-108: the transport under test comes from this commit (the sensitivity control on the 253-104 defect).
        content = run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "show", f"{args.transport_from}:{TRANSPORT_REL}"]).stdout
        (clone / TRANSPORT_REL).write_bytes(content)
        git(clone, "add", TRANSPORT_REL)
        changed = True
    if changed:
        git(clone, "add", DRIVER_REL)
        git(clone, "commit", "-qm", "dry-run: driver and helpers under test", "--allow-empty")
    phase = clone / PHASE_REL
    publisher = clone / "scripts/ci/ci-git-publication.py"
    env = scrubbed_env(work)
    if args.revision_freeze:
        freeze_rel = args.revision_freeze
        freeze_plan = json.loads((clone / freeze_rel).read_text()).get("plan")
    else:
        server_parent = args.server_parent or json.loads((ROOT / R7_FREEZE_REL).read_text())["identity"]["server_parent_sha"]
        manifest_rel = f"{PHASE_REL}/253-DRYRUN-CANARY-PUBLICATION.json"
        candidate_source = git(clone, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
        main_record_args = []
        if args.ref_pair in PUBLISHER.MAIN_FRESHNESS_PAIRS:
            # 253-138/253-166: an r12 or r13 freeze must sit on a recorded fresh main. The harness satisfies that guard (never skips it)
            # with a synthetic main-fetch record whose fetched_main_sha is its own synthetic server parent, and points the
            # clone's origin/main at that parent. Both live only in this temporary clone; the real checkout's refs are
            # never written.
            record_rel = f"{PHASE_REL}/253-DRYRUN-MAIN-FETCH-R12.json"
            record = {"schema_version": "sigra.phase253.main-fetch/r12", "status": "fetched", "synthetic": True,
                      "decided_by": "dry-run-synthetic", "fetched_main_sha": server_parent, "fetch_head_sha": server_parent,
                      "fetched_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
                      "note": "dry-run synthetic main-fetch record (fetched_main_sha = server parent); no fetch was made"}
            (clone / record_rel).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
            git(clone, "update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", server_parent)
            main_record_args = ["--main-record", record_rel]
        run(["python3", str(publisher), "--prepare", "--candidate-source", candidate_source,
             "--server-parent", server_parent, "--repo-root", str(clone), "--output", str(clone / manifest_rel),
             "--fixture-file", FIXTURE_REL, "--workflow-path", ".github/workflows/ci.yml", *main_record_args], env=env)
        if main_record_args:
            git(clone, "add", record_rel)
            git(clone, "commit", "-qm", "dry-run: synthetic main-fetch record (fetched_main_sha = server parent)")
        git(clone, "add", manifest_rel)
        git(clone, "commit", "-qm", "dry-run: synthetic publication manifest")
        freeze_rel = f"{PHASE_REL}/253-DRYRUN-CANARY-FREEZE.json"
        build = ["python3", str(publisher), "--build-freeze", "--manifest", manifest_rel, "--output", freeze_rel,
                 "--repo-root", str(clone)]
        if args.ref_pair:
            build += ["--ref-pair", args.ref_pair]
        run(build, env=env)
        git(clone, "add", freeze_rel)
        git(clone, "commit", "-qm", "dry-run: synthetic freeze")
        freeze_plan = json.loads((clone / freeze_rel).read_text()).get("plan")
    freeze_path = clone / freeze_rel
    freeze = json.loads(freeze_path.read_text())
    approval_rel = f"{PHASE_REL}/253-DRYRUN-CANARY-ACTION-APPROVAL.json"
    approval = {"schema_version": "sigra.phase253.outward-action-approval/v1", "decision": "approve", "section": "canary",
                "section_sha256": freeze["outward_actions_sha256"]["canary"], "decided_by": "dry-run-synthetic",
                "recorded_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")}
    (clone / approval_rel).write_text(json.dumps(approval, indent=2) + "\n")
    git(clone, "add", approval_rel)
    git(clone, "commit", "-qm", "dry-run: synthetic canary approval (decided_by dry-run-synthetic)")
    return {"clone": clone, "phase": phase, "freeze_path": freeze_path, "freeze": freeze, "freeze_plan": freeze_plan,
            "approval": clone / approval_rel}


def scrubbed_env(work: Path, extra: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    bin_dir = work / "recorder-bin"
    bin_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    marker = work / "network-commands"
    for name in ("gh", "curl", "wget"):
        stub = bin_dir / name
        stub.write_text(f'#!/bin/sh\nprintf "{name} %s\\n" "$*" >> "{marker}"\nexit 97\n')
        stub.chmod(0o755)
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
           if key not in {"GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"} and not key.startswith("SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_")}
    (work / "home").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (work / "tmp").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    env.update({"PATH": f"{bin_dir}:{env['PATH']}", "HOME": str(work / "home"), "TMPDIR": str(work / "tmp"),
                "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT": "0"})
    env.update(extra or {})
    return env


SLEEP_RECORDER = """#!/bin/sh
# 253-108 recording sleep: logs the requested duration and the category of the last charged request (so a wait is
# classified by what preceded it, not by its value), then sleeps only the scaled fraction.
last=$(jq -r '(.transactions // [])[-1].category // "none"' {ledger} 2>/dev/null) || last=none
printf '%s %s\\n' "$1" "${{last:-none}}" >> {log}
exec /bin/sleep "$(awk -v d="$1" -v s={scale} 'BEGIN {{ printf "%.3f", d * s }}')"
"""


SITECUSTOMIZE_CHAIN = '''# 253-108 runner: the shim's sitecustomize shadows the interpreter's own (Homebrew's adds its site-packages, where
# PyYAML lives), so load the next sitecustomize on sys.path first. Paths only; no network behaviour changes.
import importlib.util as _chain_util
import os as _chain_os
import sys as _chain_sys
_chain_here = _chain_os.path.dirname(_chain_os.path.abspath(__file__))
for _chain_entry in list(_chain_sys.path):
    _chain_dir = _chain_os.path.abspath(_chain_entry or ".")
    _chain_file = _chain_os.path.join(_chain_dir, "sitecustomize.py")
    if _chain_dir != _chain_here and _chain_os.path.isfile(_chain_file):
        _chain_spec = _chain_util.spec_from_file_location("_sigra_chained_sitecustomize", _chain_file)
        _chain_spec.loader.exec_module(_chain_util.module_from_spec(_chain_spec))
        break
'''


def chain_interpreter_sitecustomize(path: Path) -> None:
    """Prepend the chain to the shim's generated sitecustomize (a work-dir copy; the shim source is unchanged)."""
    path.write_text(SITECUSTOMIZE_CHAIN + path.read_text())


def install_recording_sleep(work: Path, ledger: Path, scale: float) -> Path:
    log = work / "requested-sleeps.log"
    stub = work / "recorder-bin" / "sleep"
    stub.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    quote = lambda value: "'" + str(value).replace("'", "'\\''") + "'"  # noqa: E731
    stub.write_text(SLEEP_RECORDER.format(ledger=quote(ledger), log=quote(log), scale=quote(scale)))
    stub.chmod(0o755)
    return log


def requested_sleeps(log: Path | None) -> dict:
    """Each requested wait, grouped by the request that preceded it: dispatch (discovery) or a watch read (poll)."""
    result = {"discovery": [], "poll": [], "other": []}
    if log is None or not log.exists():
        return result
    for line in log.read_text().splitlines():
        duration, _, last = line.partition(" ")
        value = float(duration)
        value = int(value) if value.is_integer() else value
        group = {"dispatch": "discovery", "pre_watch_rate": "poll", "terminal_polls": "poll"}.get(last.strip(), "other")
        result[group].append(value if group != "other" else {"seconds": value, "after": last.strip()})
    return result


def category_counts(ledger: dict) -> dict:
    counts: dict = {}
    for row in ledger.get("transactions", []):
        counts[row.get("category")] = counts.get(row.get("category"), 0) + 1
    return counts

        port = server.server_address[1]

                                          {"path": str(clone / manifest["path"]), "sha256": manifest["sha256"]},

                      "test_origin": f"https://localhost:{port}", "test_ca_file": str(cert)}
        sleep_log = None

        allocation_path = work / ("live-policy-canary-allocation.json" if live else "hermetic-canary-allocation.json")

                                                                  "max_requests", "max_pages", "max_hops")}

        if not live:

        common = ["--revision-freeze", str(freeze_path), "--action-approval", str(prepared["approval"]),
                  "--http-allocation", str(allocation_path), "--requests", str(ledger), "--evidence", str(evidence),
                  "--publication-receipt", str(receipt)]
        steps = [("publish-only", ["--publish-only"]), ("full-pass", ["--scenario", "full-pass"])]
        if args.stop_after != "full-pass":

        invocations = []
        failed = None

        def ledger_rows():
            return json.loads(ledger.read_text()).get("transactions", []) if ledger.exists() else []

        def invoke(label, mode):
            before = len(ledger_rows())
            result = subprocess.run(["bash", str(clone / DRIVER_REL), *mode, *common], cwd=clone, env=env,
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=args.timeout)
            added = ledger_rows()[before:]
            record = {"mode": label, "exit": result.returncode, "stop": stop_line(result.stderr) if result.returncode else None,
                      "requests": len(added), "requests_by_category": category_counts({"transactions": added}),
                      "retained_preflight_reverified": "retained preflight re-verified" in result.stdout}
            if args.verbose:
                sys.stderr.write(f"--- {label} exit {result.returncode}\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}")
            return result, record

        for label, mode in steps:
            result, record = invoke(label, mode)
            invocations.append(record)
            if result.returncode:
                failed = (label, result.returncode, stop_line(result.stderr))
                if args.reenter:
                    _, again = invoke(label + " (re-entry)", mode)

        summary["invocations"] = invocations
        ledger_value = json.loads(ledger.read_text()) if ledger.exists() else {"transactions": []}

                                       cwd=clone, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)

        if failed is None and args.stop_after != "full-pass":

                                    cwd=clone, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)

        elif failed is not None:
            summary["verifier"] = {"status": "failed" if summary["scenarios"] or evidence_value.get("scenarios") else "pending"}
        limits = freeze["categories"]["canary"]

        problems = []

        if summary["requests_by_category"].get("infrastructure_retry"):

        if summary["journal_requests"] != summary["requests_total"]:

        # 253-117: every run object the fake served must have GitHub's recorded shape.

                problems.append(f"a seeded r11 ref changed: {changed}")
        if getattr(args, "seed_r12_refs", False):
            changed = {name: server.refs.get(name) for name, sha in R12_REFS.items() if server.refs.get(name) != sha}
            summary["seeded_r12_refs_changed"] = bool(changed)
            if changed:
                problems.append(f"a seeded r12 ref changed: {changed}")
        expected = ["full-pass"] if args.stop_after == "full-pass" else list(SCENARIOS)
        if failed is None and summary["scenarios"] != expected:
            problems.append(f"verifier accepted {summary['scenarios']}, expected {expected}")
        if failed is None and args.stop_after != "full-pass" and summary["verifier"]["status"] != "passed":
            problems.append("the verifier's --mode canary --scenario matrix did not pass")
        summary["problems"] = problems
        summary["status"] = "passed" if not problems else "failed"
    except (DryRunError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        summary["stop"] = summary["stop"] or f"dry-run setup: {error}"
        summary.setdefault("problems", []).append(str(error))
    finally:
        if server is not None:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
        summary["modeled_elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
        if args.keep:
            summary["work_dir"] = str(work)
        else:
            shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    return summary


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n", 1)[0])
    parser.add_argument("--stop-after", choices=("full-pass", "all"), default="all",
                        help="end after this scenario's receipt is verified (default: the whole sequence)")

    parser.add_argument("--seed-r10-refs", action="store_true",

                             "(combinable with --seed-r8-refs and --seed-r9-refs)")
    parser.add_argument("--seed-r11-refs", action="store_true",

    parser.add_argument("--seed-r12-refs", action="store_true",

    parser.add_argument("--ref-pair", choices=sorted(PUBLISHER.REF_PAIRS),

                             f"({', '.join(sorted(PUBLISHER.REF_PAIRS))}; the publisher's default is "

    parser.add_argument("--revision-freeze", help="use this committed freeze (repository-relative) instead of deriving one")
    parser.add_argument("--server-parent", help="server parent for the derived synthetic freeze (default: the R7 freeze's)")
    parser.add_argument("--visibility-delay", type=float, default=None,
                        help="modeled seconds before a dispatched run is listable (default 3; 0.05 with --live-policy)")
    parser.add_argument("--discovery-wait", type=float, default=None,
                        help="hermetic-only SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_DISCOVERY_WAIT_SECONDS (default 4; live is 20)")
    parser.add_argument("--poll-seconds", type=float, default=None,
                        help="hermetic-only SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_POLL_SECONDS (default 0.05)")
    parser.add_argument("--transport-from", help="substitute the clone's ci-hosted-transport.py with this commit's blob")
    parser.add_argument("--live-policy", action="store_true",
                        help="253-108: a live canary allocation through the live-policy shim (see the module docstring)")
    parser.add_argument("--repos-link-form", action="store_true",
                        help="253-164: live-policy with --transport-from only: serve the server parent's check_runs Link "
                             "headers in the pre-146 /repos/<owner>/<repo>/ form on api.github.com, for the 253-108 "
                             "sensitivity transports (375b41138 and its parent); refused for a transport that already "
                             "accepts the /repositories/<id>/ form")
    parser.add_argument("--paged-listings", action="store_true",
                        help="253-165: serve the full-pass run's run_jobs and run_artifacts listings as two pages each, "
                             "with rel next/last in this mode's link form (live-policy /repositories/<id>/, hermetic "
                             "/repos/); default off; refused together with --repos-link-form")
    parser.add_argument("--sleep-scale", type=float, default=0.01,
                        help="live-policy: fraction of each requested driver sleep actually slept (default 0.01)")
    parser.add_argument("--polls", action="append", help="SCENARIO=N modeled polls to completion (repeatable)")
    parser.add_argument("--inject", action="append", help="'METHOD /path=STATUS': answer that request once with STATUS")
    parser.add_argument("--reenter", action="store_true", help="after a failed driver mode, run it once more (halt guard check)")
    parser.add_argument("--fault", action="append",
                        choices=("artifact-digest", "run-shape-bare-name", "run-logs-legacy-blob-redirect",
                                 "cancelled-shape-drift"),
                        help="modeled server fault (artifact-digest: listed digest differs from the served bytes; "
                             "run-shape-bare-name: every run is served in the pre-253-117 shape, bare name and path@ref; "
                             "run-logs-legacy-blob-redirect: failed logs take the pre-R11 blob-host redirect; "
                             "cancelled-shape-drift: the cancelled run's cancelled job reports failure)")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=900, help="seconds allowed per driver invocation")
    parser.add_argument("--overlay-worktree", action="store_true",
                        help="copy the checkout's uncommitted scripts/ci edits into the clone (test aid; recorded)")
    parser.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.live_policy and (args.discovery_wait is not None or args.poll_seconds is not None):
        parser.error("--discovery-wait and --poll-seconds are hermetic-only; live-policy runs the live 20/60-second waits")
    if args.sleep_scale < 0:
        parser.error("--sleep-scale must be non-negative")
    if args.paged_listings and args.repos_link_form:
        parser.error(PAGED_LISTINGS_WITH_REPOS_LINK_FORM)
    if args.repos_link_form and not (args.live_policy and args.transport_from):
        parser.error(REPOS_LINK_FORM_SCOPE)
    for key in ("GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"):
        os.environ.pop(key, None)
    summary = dry_run(args)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if summary["status"] == "passed" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline gate tests for ci-gate-canary-dryrun.py and the driver behaviour it exposes (253-101).

Every run happens in a temporary clone against the local HTTPS fake. The runner is invoked with --overlay-worktree so
the tests exercise the checkout's current scripts/ci files; nothing reaches GitHub (no credentials, recorder gh/curl).
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
RUNNER = ROOT / "scripts/ci/ci-gate-canary-dryrun.py"
DRIVER_REL = "scripts/ci/ci-gate-canary.sh"
R7_DRIVER = "97665bd2a56443a2bb10f894aafd46c5f06e4ce9"


def load_runner():
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ci_gate_canary_dryrun_under_test", RUNNER)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def clean_env():
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
           if key not in {"GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"} and not key.startswith("SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_")}
    env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
    return env


def run_gate(*args, timeout=1800):
    """Run the dry-run gate; returns (exit code, summary)."""
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(RUNNER), "--overlay-worktree", *args], cwd=ROOT, env=clean_env(),
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    try:
        summary = json.loads(result.stdout)
    except ValueError:
        raise AssertionError(f"runner printed no JSON summary (exit {result.returncode}): {result.stderr[-2000:]}")
    return result.returncode, summary


class LiveOverrideRefusalTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """With a live allocation every SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_* override stops the driver before any request or evidence."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.runner = load_runner()
        cls.work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="sigra-253-override-")).resolve()
        args = argparse.Namespace(overlay_worktree=True, driver_from=None, driver_patch=None, revision_freeze=None,
                                  server_parent=None, ref_pair=None, overlaid=[])
        cls.prepared = cls.runner.prepare_clone(args, cls.work)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        shutil.rmtree(cls.work, ignore_errors=True)

    def live_allocation(self):
        freeze_path = self.prepared["freeze_path"]
        value = {"schema_version": "sigra.phase253.http-allocation/v1", "window_id": "253-101-override-refusal",
                 "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(freeze_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "max_requests": 117,
                 "max_elapsed_seconds": 3600, "max_response_bytes": 4 * 1024 * 1024, "max_pages": 3, "max_hops": 2,
                 "repository": "szTheory/sigra", "download_hosts": [], "mode": "live", "allocation_kind": "canary",
                 "category_limits": self.prepared["freeze"]["categories"]["canary"]}
        path = self.work / "live-allocation.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value))
        return path

    def test_every_test_override_is_refused_with_a_live_allocation_before_any_request(self):
        clone, phase = self.prepared["clone"], self.prepared["phase"]
        allocation = self.live_allocation()
        for variable in ("SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_POLL_SECONDS", "SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_SERVER_JOURNAL",
                         "SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_DISCOVERY_WAIT_SECONDS", "SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_ANYTHING"):
            for mode in (["--publish-only"], ["--scenario", "full-pass"], ["--remaining-scenarios"]):
                with self.subTest(variable=variable, mode=mode[0]):
                    evidence, ledger = phase / "override-evidence.json", phase / "override-ledger.json"
                    env = self.runner.scrubbed_env(self.work, {variable: "1"})
                    marker = self.work / "network-commands"
                    result = subprocess.run(
                        ["bash", str(clone / DRIVER_REL), *mode, "--revision-freeze", str(self.prepared["freeze_path"]),
                         "--action-approval", str(self.prepared["approval"]), "--http-allocation", str(allocation),
                         "--requests", str(ledger), "--evidence", str(evidence)],
                        cwd=clone, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
                    self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
                    self.assertIn(variable, result.stderr)
                    self.assertIn("refused with a live allocation", result.stderr)
                    self.assertFalse(evidence.exists(), "evidence was written before the override refusal")
                    self.assertFalse(ledger.exists(), "a request was charged before the override refusal")
                    self.assertFalse(marker.exists(), "a network command ran before the override refusal")

    def test_the_same_live_allocation_without_overrides_gets_past_the_refusal(self):
        clone, phase = self.prepared["clone"], self.prepared["phase"]
        env = self.runner.scrubbed_env(self.work)
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["bash", str(clone / DRIVER_REL), "--scenario", "full-pass", "--revision-freeze", str(self.prepared["freeze_path"]),
             "--action-approval", str(self.prepared["approval"]), "--http-allocation", str(self.live_allocation()),
             "--requests", str(phase / "control-ledger.json"), "--evidence", str(phase / "control-evidence.json")],
            cwd=clone, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
        # Positive control: with no override the live path proceeds to its first request, which the recorder gh
        # refuses for lack of credentials (nothing leaves the machine).
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertNotIn("refused with a live allocation", result.stderr)
        ledger = json.loads((phase / "control-ledger.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(ledger["transactions"][0]["error"]["code"], "authentication_unavailable")
        self.assertEqual((self.work / "network-commands").read_text().split()[:3], ["gh", "auth", "token"])

class HaltMarkingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Commit D: every nonzero exit after the evidence exists leaves it halted, and the guard refuses re-entry."""

def patch_file(directory, name, old, new):
    path = Path(directory) / f"{name}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps({"name": name, "old": old, "new": new}))
    return path


class SensitivityControlTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Each control reintroduces one fixed defect into a copy of the driver; the gate must fail at its named point."""

    def control(self, name, old, new, *extra):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            text = (ROOT / DRIVER_REL).read_text()
            self.assertEqual(text.count(old), 1, f"reintroduction patch {name} must apply exactly once")
            code, summary = run_gate("--driver-patch", str(patch_file(directory, name, old, new)), *extra)
        self.assertNotEqual(code, 0, f"the gate is blind to {name}: {summary}")
        self.assertEqual(summary["status"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(summary["driver_patch"], name)
        return summary

    def test_check_source_candidate(self):
        summary = self.control("check-source-candidate",
                               'api_get "commits/$CHECK_SOURCE_SHA/check-runs?per_page=100" "$CHECK_RUNS_RESPONSE"',
                               'api_get "commits/$CANDIDATE_SHA/check-runs?per_page=100" "$CHECK_RUNS_RESPONSE"',
                               "--stop-after", "full-pass")
        self.assertIn("native check-run app/source identity is missing", summary["stop"], summary)
        self.assertEqual(summary["invocations"][-1]["mode"], "full-pass")

    def test_errexit_tail(self):
        summary = self.control("errexit-tail",
                               "  # The guard above is false for every expected outcome; without this the function returned 1 and set -e ended the run.\n  return 0\n}",
                               "}", "--stop-after", "full-pass")
        # Without the explicit success return the function ends on its negative-source guard, which returns 1 for
        # every expected outcome; the ERR trap names that guard line and the run ends right after the full-pass receipt.
        self.assertIn('"$case_name" == unexpected-skip ]]', summary["stop"], summary)
        self.assertEqual(summary["invocations"][-1]["mode"], "full-pass")
        self.assertEqual(summary["scenarios"], ["full-pass"], "it stops right after the full-pass receipt")
        self.assertEqual(summary["evidence_status"], "halted")

    def test_preflight_repeat(self):
        summary = self.control("preflight-repeat", "if retained_preflight; then", "if false && retained_preflight; then")
        self.assertEqual(summary["invocations"][-1]["mode"], "remaining")
        self.assertIn("category preflight allocation is exhausted", summary["stop"], summary)

    def test_halt_unmarked(self):
        route = f"GET /repos/szTheory/sigra/commits/{SERVER_PARENT}/check-runs=403"
        summary = self.control("halt-unmarked", "trap 'on_command_error \"$?\" \"$LINENO\" \"$BASH_COMMAND\"' ERR\n", "",
                               "--stop-after", "full-pass", "--inject", route)
        self.assertIn("http_403", summary["stop"], summary)
        self.assertIsNone(summary["evidence_status"], "with the fail routing removed the refusal leaves no halt")

class FakeGitHubStrictnessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """The fake rejects any request GitHub's API would not take for that route."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.runner = load_runner()

    def test_unknown_paths_queries_bodies_and_credentials_are_refused_and_recorded(self):
        import http.client
        import ssl
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            work = Path(directory).resolve()
            clone = work / "clone"
            subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "-q", "--shared", "--no-checkout", str(ROOT), str(clone)], check=True)
            parent = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
            server, thread, cert = self.runner.start_fake(work, clone, work / "ledger.json", work / "journal.json", parent,
                                                          None, 0.0, dict(self.runner.DEFAULT_POLLS), False)
            try:
                server.refs["gsd/253-replan-fixture"] = parent
                context = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cert))
                cases = [
                    ("GET", "/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/workflows/259268962/runs?event=push&branch=x&per_page=100&page=1", None, {}),
                    ("GET", "/repos/szTheory/sigra/rules/branches/main?per_page=30&page=1", None, {}),
                    ("GET", "/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/runs/1/jobs", None, {}),
                    ("POST", "/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/workflows/259268962/dispatches",
                     {"ref": "gsd/253-replan-fixture", "inputs": {"scenario": "full-pass", "unknown": "x"}}, {}),
                    ("POST", "/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/workflows/259268962/dispatches",
                     {"ref": "gsd/does-not-exist", "inputs": {"scenario": "full-pass", "candidate_sha": "a", "fixture_sha": "b",
                                                              "fixture_blob": "c"}}, {}),
                    ("POST", "/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/runs/1/cancel", {"force": True}, {}),
                    ("DELETE", "/repos/szTheory/sigra/git/refs/heads/main", None, {}),
                    ("GET", "/rate_limit", None, {"Authorization": "Bearer ghp_dryruntokenvalue"}),
                ]
                statuses = []
                for method, path, body, headers in cases:
                    connection = http.client.HTTPSConnection("localhost", server.server_address[1], context=context, timeout=10)
                    payload = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
                    connection.request(method, path, body=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", **headers})
                    statuses.append(connection.getresponse().status)
                    connection.close()
                self.assertTrue(all(status >= 400 for status in statuses), statuses)
                self.assertGreaterEqual(len(server.violations), len(cases) - 1, server.violations)
                self.assertTrue(any("credential" in item for item in server.violations))
                self.assertEqual(server.runs, {}, "a refused dispatch must not create a run")
            finally:
                server.shutdown()
                server.server_close()

def live_run(*args):
    """A live-policy gate run, cached per argument list for the classes that only read its summary."""
    if args not in _LIVE_RUNS:

def ledger_body(path, route, sequence=None):
    """The decoded response body GitHub returned for this route (first match, or the given sequence)."""
    import base64
    for row in json.loads(Path(path).read_text())["transactions"]:
        if row.get("route_id") == route and (sequence is None or row.get("sequence") == sequence):
            return json.loads(base64.b64decode(row["response_body_base64"]))

def ledger_rows(path):
    return {row["sequence"]: row for row in json.loads(Path(path).read_text())["transactions"]}


class FakeChainHarness:
    """Starts the dry-run fake (hermetic or live-policy) and fetches one run's failed-log chain the way the transport
    does: a charged pending ledger row per hop, hop 0 on api.github.com, then the Location it was given."""

    def __init__(self, runner, live, faults=()):
        import ssl
        self.runner, self.live = runner, live
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sigra-253-128-chain-")
        self.work = Path(self.directory.name).resolve()
        clone = self.work / "clone"
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "-q", "--shared", "--no-checkout", str(ROOT), str(clone)], check=True)
        parent = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
        self.ledger, self.journal = self.work / "ledger.json", self.work / "journal.json"
        self.server, _, self.cert = runner.start_fake(self.work, clone, self.ledger, self.journal, parent, None, 0.0,
                                                      dict(runner.DEFAULT_POLLS), False, live=live)
        self.server.faults = set(faults)
        self.port = self.server.server_address[1]
        self.ssl = ssl

    def close(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def add_failed_run(self, run_id=40000000777, scenario="actual-failure"):
        self.server.runs[run_id] = {"id": run_id, "run_number": 777, "scenario": scenario, "inputs": {},
                                    "head_branch": "gsd/253-replan-r10-fixture", "head_sha": "0" * 40, "visible_at": 0,
                                    "polls": 3, "needed": 3, "cancel_requested": False, "completed": True,
                                    "conclusion": "failure"}
        return run_id

    def get(self, host, path, hop):
        import http.client
        url = f"https://{host}{path.split('?', 1)[0]}" + ("?[REDACTED]" if "?" in path else "")
        self.ledger.write_text(json.dumps({"transactions": [{"state": "pending", "method": "GET", "url": url,
                                                             "route_id": "run_logs", "hop_ordinal": hop, "host": host}]}))
        if self.live:
            shim = load_shim_module()
            with shim.patched({host: self.port}, self.cert, self.work / "connect.jsonl"):
                connection = http.client.HTTPSConnection(host, 443, context=self.ssl.create_default_context(), timeout=10)
                headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.runner.LIVE_TOKEN}"} if host == "api.github.com" else {}
                connection.request("GET", path, headers=headers)
                response = connection.getresponse()
                result = (response.status, response.getheaders(), response.read())
                connection.close()
        else:
            context = self.ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.cert))
            connection = http.client.HTTPSConnection("localhost", self.port, context=context, timeout=10)
            connection.request("GET", path)
            response = connection.getresponse()
            result = (response.status, response.getheaders(), response.read())
            connection.close()
        self.ledger.unlink()
        return result

    def chain(self, run_id):
        from urllib.parse import urlsplit
        hops = [self.get("api.github.com" if self.live else "localhost", f"/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/runs/{run_id}/logs", 0)]
        while hops[-1][0] in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308) and len(hops) <= 2:
            location = dict((name.lower(), value) for name, value in hops[-1][1])["location"]
            parsed = urlsplit(location)
            hops.append(self.get(parsed.hostname, parsed.path + ("?" + parsed.query if parsed.query else ""), len(hops)))
        return hops


def load_shim_module():
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ci_live_policy_shim_for_dryrun_test", ROOT / "scripts/ci/ci-live-policy-shim.py")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

class DryRunR12MainRecordTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """253-138: the derived-freeze path of prepare_clone satisfies the r12 main-freshness guard with a synthetic main-fetch
    record committed inside its temporary clone and bound to its own synthetic server parent; it never skips the guard,
    and the real checkout's refs are never written. Earlier pairs are unchanged."""

    PAIRS = ("r12", "r11", None)
    REAL_REFS = ("refs/remotes/origin/main", "refs/heads/main")
    RECORD_REL = ".planning/phases/253-fix-flaky-ci-and-preserve-required-checks/253-DRYRUN-MAIN-FETCH-R12.json"
    RECORD_SUBJECT = "dry-run: synthetic main-fetch record (fetched_main_sha = server parent)"

    @classmethod
    def git(cls, repo, *args, check=True):
        result = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if check and result.returncode:
            raise AssertionError(f"git {' '.join(args)} failed: {result.stderr}")
        return result.stdout.strip()

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.runner = load_runner()
        cls.real_before = {ref: cls.git(ROOT, "rev-parse", ref) for ref in cls.REAL_REFS}
        cls.works, cls.prepared = [], {}
        try:
            for pair in cls.PAIRS:
                work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f"sigra-253-main-record-{pair or 'default'}-")).resolve()
                cls.works.append(work)
                args = argparse.Namespace(overlay_worktree=True, driver_from=None, driver_patch=None, revision_freeze=None,
                                          server_parent=None, ref_pair=pair, overlaid=[])
                cls.prepared[pair] = cls.runner.prepare_clone(args, work)
        finally:
            cls.real_after = {ref: cls.git(ROOT, "rev-parse", ref) for ref in cls.REAL_REFS}

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        for work in cls.works:
            shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)

    def manifest(self, prepared):
        rel = prepared["freeze"]["bound_documents"]["publication_manifest"]["path"]
        return json.loads((prepared["clone"] / rel).read_text())

    def test_the_r12_clone_commits_a_synthetic_main_record_bound_to_its_server_parent(self):
        prepared = self.prepared["r12"]
        clone, freeze = prepared["clone"], prepared["freeze"]
        parent = freeze["identity"]["server_parent_sha"]
        record_path = clone / self.RECORD_REL
        record = json.loads(record_path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual((record["schema_version"], record["status"], record["synthetic"], record["decided_by"]),
                         ("sigra.phase253.main-fetch/r12", "fetched", True, "dry-run-synthetic"))
        self.assertEqual((record["fetched_main_sha"], record["fetch_head_sha"]), (parent, parent))
        self.assertEqual(self.git(clone, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", self.RECORD_REL), self.RECORD_REL)
        self.assertEqual(self.git(clone, "status", "--porcelain", "--", self.RECORD_REL), "")
        self.assertEqual(self.git(clone, "rev-parse", "refs/remotes/origin/main"), parent)
        manifest = self.manifest(prepared)
        fresh = manifest["main_freshness"]
        self.assertEqual(fresh["fetched_main_sha"], parent)
        self.assertEqual(fresh["record_path"], self.RECORD_REL)
        self.assertIs(fresh["merge_preflight"]["clean"], True)
        self.assertIs(fresh["candidate_parent_is_fetched_main"], True)
        record_sha = hashlib.sha256(record_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        self.assertEqual(freeze["bound_documents"]["main_freshness_record"], {"path": self.RECORD_REL, "sha256": record_sha})
        # The record has its own commit, before the publication commit, and the candidate source is the commit before it.
        subjects = self.git(clone, "log", "--format=%s", "-n", "6").splitlines()
        self.assertIn(self.RECORD_SUBJECT, subjects)
        self.assertLess(subjects.index("dry-run: synthetic publication manifest"), subjects.index(self.RECORD_SUBJECT))
        record_commit = self.git(clone, "log", "--format=%H", "--fixed-strings", f"--grep={self.RECORD_SUBJECT}", "-n", "1")
        self.assertEqual(self.git(clone, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", record_commit), self.RECORD_REL)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["source_sha"], self.git(clone, "rev-parse", f"{record_commit}^"))

    def test_a_manifest_stripped_of_main_freshness_is_refused_inside_the_same_clone(self):
        prepared = self.prepared["r12"]
        clone = prepared["clone"]
        publisher = clone / "scripts/ci/ci-git-publication.py"
        manifest = self.manifest(prepared)
        del manifest["main_freshness"]
        stripped_rel = ".planning/phases/253-fix-flaky-ci-and-preserve-required-checks/253-DRYRUN-STRIPPED-PUBLICATION.json"
        (clone / stripped_rel).write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
        self.git(clone, "add", stripped_rel)
        self.git(clone, "commit", "-qm", "dry-run test: manifest stripped of main_freshness")

        def build(manifest_rel, output_rel):
            return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(publisher), "--build-freeze", "--manifest", manifest_rel, "--output",
                                   output_rel, "--repo-root", str(clone), "--ref-pair", "r12"],
                                  cwd=ROOT, env=clean_env(), capture_output=True, text=True)
        refused_rel = ".planning/phases/253-fix-flaky-ci-and-preserve-required-checks/253-DRYRUN-STRIPPED-FREEZE.json"
        refused = build(stripped_rel, refused_rel)
        self.assertNotEqual(refused.returncode, 0, "the stripped manifest built an r12 freeze: the guard was bypassed")
        self.assertIn("main_freshness", refused.stderr)
        self.assertFalse((clone / refused_rel).exists())
        # Positive control: the harness's own manifest still builds an r12 freeze in the same clone.
        control_rel = ".planning/phases/253-fix-flaky-ci-and-preserve-required-checks/253-DRYRUN-CONTROL-FREEZE.json"
        control = build(prepared["freeze"]["bound_documents"]["publication_manifest"]["path"], control_rel)
        self.assertEqual(control.returncode, 0, control.stderr)
        (clone / control_rel).unlink()

    def test_earlier_pairs_get_no_synthetic_record_main_freshness_or_binding(self):
        for pair in ("r11", None):
            with self.subTest(pair=pair):
                prepared = self.prepared[pair]
                self.assertFalse((prepared["clone"] / self.RECORD_REL).exists())
                self.assertNotIn("main_freshness", self.manifest(prepared))
                self.assertEqual(set(prepared["freeze"]["bound_documents"]), {"publication_manifest", "fixture_workflow"})
                self.assertNotIn(self.RECORD_SUBJECT, self.git(prepared["clone"], "log", "--format=%s", "-n", "6"))

    def test_the_real_checkout_refs_never_move_and_the_clone_ref_is_its_own(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.real_after, self.real_before)
        clone_main = self.git(self.prepared["r12"]["clone"], "rev-parse", "refs/remotes/origin/main")
        # Positive control: the clone's origin/main is the R7 synthetic parent, not the real checkout's origin/main.
        self.assertEqual(clone_main, self.prepared["r12"]["freeze"]["identity"]["server_parent_sha"])
        self.assertNotEqual(clone_main, self.real_before["refs/remotes/origin/main"])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline route-mapping regressions for ci-gate-canary.sh (253-100).

The real api_get, download_no_follow, transport_call, request_category and
record_budget functions are extracted from the script text and run in bash
with a recording stub transport. The stub records each request envelope the
real transport_call builds and returns a canned 200 receipt. Nothing reaches
any network: gh and curl on PATH are recorders that fail the test if called.
"""
import base64
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
RUNNER = ROOT / 'scripts/ci/ci-gate-canary.sh'
SHA = '84ebcea60024c9e8caee405d55cad1c76b0e858a'
BRANCH = 'gsd/253-replan-fixture'
EXTRACTED = ('request_category', 'transport_call', 'record_budget', 'api_get', 'download_no_follow')

STUB_TRANSPORT = r'''
import json, os, sys
args = sys.argv[1:]
def value(flag):
    return args[args.index(flag) + 1]
request = json.load(open(value('--request')))
flags = [a for a in args if a in ('--fetch-pages', '--follow-download')]
with open(os.environ['ROUTE_RECORD'], 'a') as handle:
    handle.write(json.dumps({'envelope': request, 'flags': flags}) + '\n')
target = value('--body-output')
if target != '/dev/null':
    with open(target, 'w') as handle:
        handle.write('{}')
with open(value('--output'), 'w') as handle:
    json.dump({'sequence': 1, 'actual_status': 200}, handle)
'''


def extract(source, name):
    match = re.search(rf'^{name}\(\) \{{.*?^\}}', source, re.M | re.S)
    return match.group(0) if match else None


class CanaryRouteMappingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        source = RUNNER.read_text()
        cls.functions = {name: extract(source, name) for name in EXTRACTED}

    def test_extracted_functions_were_found(self):
        for name, text in self.functions.items():
            with self.subTest(function=name):
                self.assertIsNotNone(text, f'{name}() not found in {RUNNER}')

    def _drive(self, call):
        """Run one real driver call against the recording stub; return (result, records, network calls)."""
        for name, text in self.functions.items():
            self.assertIsNotNone(text, f'{name}() not found in {RUNNER}')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            tmp = Path(directory)
            stub = tmp / 'stub-transport.py'
            stub.write_text(STUB_TRANSPORT)
            record = tmp / 'records.jsonl'
            marker = tmp / 'network-calls'
            bin_dir = tmp / 'bin'
            bin_dir.mkdir()
            for name in ('gh', 'curl'):
                recorder = bin_dir / name
                recorder.write_text(f'#!/bin/sh\nprintf "{name} %s\\n" "$*" >> "$NETWORK_MARKER"\nexit 99\n')
                recorder.chmod(0o755)
            prelude = (
                'set -euo pipefail\n'
                'export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1\n'
                'fail() { printf "ci-gate-canary: FAIL: %s\\n" "$*" >&2; exit 1; }\n'
                f'WORK_DIR="{tmp}"\n'
                f'TRANSPORT_MODULE="{stub}"\n'
                f'REQUEST_LEDGER="{tmp}/absent-ledger.json"\n'
                f'EVIDENCE="{tmp}/absent-evidence.json"\n'
                'LIVE_ALLOCATION=stub-allocation\nREQUEST_COUNT=0\nCANARY_STARTED_EPOCH=0\n'
                'LAST_REQUEST_STATUS=""\n'
            )
            body = '\n'.join(self.functions.values()) + '\n' + call + '\necho route-call-returned\n'
            env = {**os.environ, 'PATH': f'{bin_dir}:{os.environ["PATH"]}', 'ROUTE_RECORD': str(record),
                   'NETWORK_MARKER': str(marker), 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'}
            result = subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', prelude + body], cwd=tmp, env=env, text=True,
                                    capture_output=True, timeout=60)
            records = [json.loads(line) for line in record.read_text().splitlines()] if record.exists() else []
            network = marker.read_text() if marker.exists() else ''
        return result, records, network

    def _assert_route(self, call, route_id, category, params, query, flags):
        result, records, network = self._drive(call)
        self.assertEqual(network, '', 'a network client was invoked')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, f'driver call failed: {result.stderr.strip()}')
        self.assertIn('route-call-returned', result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(len(records), 1, f'expected exactly one transport call, got {records}')
        envelope = records[0]['envelope']

class CanaryPreflightCheckSourceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Run the real preflight read block of ci-gate-canary.sh with a recording api_get stub (D-12 decision)."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        source = RUNNER.read_text()
        match = re.search(r'^RATE_RESPONSE="\$\(mktemp .*?(?=^store_preflight "\$RATE_RESPONSE")', source, re.M | re.S)
        cls.block = match.group(0) if match else None

    def _preflight(self, check_runs, check_source_sha=SERVER_PARENT):
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.block, 'preflight read block not found in ci-gate-canary.sh')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            tmp = Path(directory)
            rules = [{'type': 'required_status_checks', 'parameters': {'required_status_checks': [
                {'context': name, 'integration_id': 15368} for name in REQUIRED_NAMES]}}]
            responses = {
                'rate': {'resources': {'core': {'remaining': 5000}}},
                'rules': rules,
                'protection': {'required_status_checks': {}},
                'checks': check_runs,
                'workflow': {'id': 259268962, 'path': '.github/workflows/ci.yml', 'state': 'active'},
            }
            for name, value in responses.items():
                (tmp / f'{name}.json').write_text(json.dumps(value))
            (tmp / 'ledger.json').write_text(json.dumps({'transactions': [
                {'route_id': 'rules_main', 'response_body_base64': base64.b64encode(json.dumps(rules).encode()).decode()}]}))
            calls = tmp / 'calls'
            stubs = (
                'set -euo pipefail\n'
                'fail() { printf "ci-gate-canary: FAIL: %s\\n" "$*" >&2; exit 1; }\n'
                f'WORK_DIR="{tmp}"\nREQUEST_LEDGER="{tmp}/ledger.json"\nWORKFLOW_ID=259268962\n'
                f'CANDIDATE_SHA={CANDIDATE}\nCHECK_SOURCE_SHA="{check_source_sha}"\n'
                'api_get() {\n'
                f'  printf "%s\\n" "$1" >> "{calls}"\n'
                '  case "$1" in\n'
                f'    rate_limit) cp "{tmp}/rate.json" "$2" ;;\n'
                f'    rules/*) cp "{tmp}/rules.json" "$2" ;;\n'
                f'    branches/*) cp "{tmp}/protection.json" "$2" ;;\n'
                f'    commits/*) cp "{tmp}/checks.json" "$2" ;;\n'
                f'    actions/workflows/*) cp "{tmp}/workflow.json" "$2" ;;\n'
                '    *) echo "unexpected endpoint $1" >&2; exit 9 ;;\n'
                '  esac\n'
                '}\n'
            )
            result = subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', stubs + self.block + '\necho preflight-reads-passed\n'],
                                    cwd=tmp, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
            endpoints = calls.read_text().splitlines() if calls.exists() else []
        return result, endpoints

    def _checks(self, runs):
        return {'total_count': len(runs), 'check_runs': runs}

    def test_preflight_reads_check_sources_from_the_frozen_server_parent(self):
        runs = [native_run(name, index) for index, name in enumerate(REQUIRED_NAMES, 1)]
        result, endpoints = self._preflight(self._checks(runs))
        check_reads = [endpoint for endpoint in endpoints if endpoint.startswith('commits/')]
        self.assertEqual(check_reads, [f'commits/{SERVER_PARENT}/check-runs?per_page=100'])
        self.assertFalse(any(CANDIDATE in endpoint for endpoint in endpoints), endpoints)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('preflight-reads-passed', result.stdout)

        conclusions = ('failure', 'success', 'cancelled', None, 'timed_out')

            'missing app slug': [native_run(REQUIRED_NAMES[0], 1, app={'id': 15368})] + base[1:],
            'missing source': [native_run(REQUIRED_NAMES[0], 1, html_url=None)] + base[1:],
            'non-https source': [native_run(REQUIRED_NAMES[0], 1, html_url='http://example.test/job/1')] + base[1:],

preserve_path() {
  local path="$1" scope="$2" status_before sha_before blob ref status_after sha_after
  [[ -f "$path" ]] || { PRESERVED_REF=""; PRESERVED_SHA=""; PRESERVED_STATUS=""; return 0; }
  status_before="$(git status --porcelain=v1 -- "$path" | tr -d '\n')"
  sha_before="$(shasum -a 256 "$path" | awk '{print $1}')"
  blob="$(git hash-object -w "$path")"
  ref="refs/gsd/phase253-12-canary-$scope/$sha_before"
  if git show-ref --verify --quiet "$ref"; then
    [[ "$(git rev-parse "$ref")" == "$blob" ]] || { echo "cannot preserve $path: content-addressed ref conflicts: $ref" >&2; exit 1; }
  else
    git update-ref "$ref" "$blob" || { echo "cannot preserve $path at $ref" >&2; exit 1; }
  fi
  [[ "$(git show "$ref" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')" == "$sha_before" ]] || { echo "cannot preserve $path: exact-byte read-back failed" >&2; exit 1; }
  status_after="$(git status --porcelain=v1 -- "$path" | tr -d '\n')"
  sha_after="$(shasum -a 256 "$path" | awk '{print $1}')"
  [[ "$status_before" == "$status_after" && "$sha_before" == "$sha_after" ]] || { echo "cannot preserve $path: source changed during preservation" >&2; exit 1; }
  PRESERVED_REF="$ref"
  PRESERVED_SHA="$sha_before"
  PRESERVED_STATUS="$status_before"
}

watch_run() {
  local run_id="$1" description="$2" rate_file core_left started run_target status conclusion lock_dir
  rate_file="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/watch-rate.XXXXXX")"
  # watch_run is always called as an if-condition, where errexit and the ERR trap are suspended, so each request
  # failure here must call fail itself; otherwise a refused poll (an exhausted category, a 403/429) loops silently
  # until the 60-minute clock (253-101: the offline gate's extra-poll model looped for 26 minutes).
  CATEGORY_OVERRIDE=pre_watch_rate api_get rate_limit "$rate_file" \
    || fail "pre-watch rate read failed for run $run_id (route rate_limit, HTTP ${LAST_REQUEST_STATUS:-none})"
  core_left="$(jq -r '.resources.core.remaining // 0' "$rate_file")"
  (( core_left > 250 )) || fail "GitHub core API budget is at or below 250 before watch (remaining=$core_left)"
  lock_dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/253-canary-poll-$run_id.lock"
  mkdir "$lock_dir" 2>/dev/null || fail "another poller already owns run $run_id"
  started="$SECONDS"
  run_target="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/terminal-run.XXXXXX")"
  while :; do
    # One interval before every poll, the first included: a run dispatched moments ago cannot be complete yet, so an
    # immediate first poll only spends one of the frozen terminal polls (253-101, commit E).
    sleep "$POLL_INTERVAL"
    check_budget 0
    (( SECONDS - started < MAX_MINUTES * 60 )) || fail "60-minute canary ceiling reached while polling run $run_id"
    api_get "actions/runs/$run_id" "$run_target" \
      || fail "terminal poll failed for run $run_id (route run, HTTP ${LAST_REQUEST_STATUS:-none})"
    status="$(jq -r '.status // empty' "$run_target")"
    conclusion="$(jq -r '.conclusion // empty' "$run_target")"
    if [[ "$status" == completed && -n "$conclusion" ]]; then
      cp "$run_target" "$TERMINAL_RUN_JSON"
      rmdir "$lock_dir"
      return 0
    fi
  done
}

  category="$(request_category "$route")"
  jq -n --arg route "$route" --arg method "$method" --arg category "$category" --argjson params "$params" --argjson query "$query" --argjson body "$body" \
    '{route_id:$route,method:$method,category:$category,params:$params,query:$query,page_ordinal:1,hop_ordinal:0,body:(if $body==null then null else $body end)}' > "$request_file"
  rc=0
  if [[ "$mode" == pages ]]; then extra=--fetch-pages; elif [[ "$mode" == download ]]; then extra=--follow-download; else extra=; fi
  python3 "$TRANSPORT_MODULE" --allocation "$LIVE_ALLOCATION" --ledger "$REQUEST_LEDGER" \
    --request "$request_file" --output "$receipt_file" --body-output "$target" $extra || rc="$?"
  if [[ -f "$REQUEST_LEDGER" ]]; then REQUEST_COUNT="$(jq '.transactions | length' "$REQUEST_LEDGER")"; fi
  if [[ -f "$receipt_file" ]]; then
    LAST_REQUEST_SEQUENCE="$(jq -r '.sequence // (.receipts[-1].sequence // 0)' "$receipt_file")"
    LAST_REQUEST_STATUS="$(jq -r '.actual_status // .receipts[-1].actual_status // empty' "$receipt_file")"
    LAST_INPUT_KEY_COUNT="$(jq -r '.input_key_count // .receipts[-1].input_key_count // empty' "$receipt_file")"
    LAST_INPUT_UNICODE_SCALARS="$(jq -r '.input_unicode_scalars // .receipts[-1].input_unicode_scalars // empty' "$receipt_file")"
    LAST_INPUT_UTF8_BYTES="$(jq -r '.input_utf8_bytes // .receipts[-1].input_utf8_bytes // empty' "$receipt_file")"
    LAST_INPUT_SHA256="$(jq -r '.input_sha256 // .receipts[-1].input_sha256 // empty' "$receipt_file")"
    if [[ -f "$EVIDENCE" ]]; then
      jq --slurpfile new_receipts "$receipt_file" \
        '.transport_receipts += (if ($new_receipts[0].receipts|type)=="array" then $new_receipts[0].receipts elif ($new_receipts[0].hops|type)=="array" then $new_receipts[0].hops else [$new_receipts[0]] end)' \
        "$EVIDENCE" > "$EVIDENCE.tmp" && mv "$EVIDENCE.tmp" "$EVIDENCE"
    fi
  fi
  record_budget
  rm -f "$request_file" "$receipt_file"
  return "$rc"
}

record_budget() {
  [[ -f "$EVIDENCE" && -f "$REQUEST_LEDGER" ]] || return 0
  temp="$EVIDENCE.tmp"
  elapsed=0
  if (( CANARY_STARTED_EPOCH > 0 )); then elapsed="$(($(date +%s) - CANARY_STARTED_EPOCH))"; fi
  preserve_evidence
  jq --slurpfile ledger "$REQUEST_LEDGER" --argjson count "$REQUEST_COUNT" --argjson elapsed "$elapsed" --arg channel "$EVIDENCE_CHANNEL" \
    '.budget.request_count=$count | .budget.elapsed_seconds=$elapsed | .transport_ledger=$ledger[0] | .origin={kind:"measured-v2",window_id:$ledger[0].window_id,source_sha256:$ledger[0].source_sha256,channel:$channel}' \
    "$EVIDENCE" > "$temp" && mv "$temp" "$EVIDENCE"
  # A hermetic window retains the local server's own journal, so the verifier's hermetic-https rule can reconcile it.
  if [[ "$HERMETIC" == true && -n "${SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_SERVER_JOURNAL:-}" && -f "$SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_SERVER_JOURNAL" ]]; then
    jq --slurpfile journal "$SIGRA_CANARY_TEST_SERVER_JOURNAL" '.server_journal=$journal[0]' "$EVIDENCE" > "$temp" && mv "$temp" "$EVIDENCE"
  fi
}

api_get() {
  endpoint="$1"; target="$2"; allow_missing=false; [[ "$#" -lt 3 ]] || allow_missing="$3"; route=""; params='{}'; query='{}'; mode=one
  if [[ "$endpoint" == rate_limit ]]; then route=rate_limit
  elif [[ "$endpoint" == 'rules/branches/main?per_page=100' ]]; then route=rules_main; query='{"per_page":100}'; mode=pages
  elif [[ "$endpoint" == branches/main/protection ]]; then route=branch_protection
  elif [[ "$endpoint" =~ ^commits/([a-f0-9]{40})/check-runs\?per_page=100$ ]]; then route=check_runs; params="$(jq -cn --arg sha "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{commit_sha:$sha}')"; query='{"per_page":100}'; mode=pages
  elif [[ "$endpoint" =~ ^actions/workflows/([0-9]+)$ ]]; then route=workflow; params="$(jq -cn --argjson id "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{workflow_id:$id}')"
  elif [[ "$endpoint" =~ ^actions/workflows/([0-9]+)/runs\?event=workflow_dispatch\&branch=([^&]+)\&per_page=100$ ]]; then
    route=workflow_runs; params="$(jq -cn --argjson id "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{workflow_id:$id}')"
    query="$(jq -cn --arg branch "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}" '{event:"workflow_dispatch",branch:$branch,per_page:100}')"; mode=pages
  elif [[ "$endpoint" =~ ^actions/runs/([0-9]+)/jobs\?per_page=100$ ]]; then route=run_jobs; params="$(jq -cn --argjson id "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{run_id:$id}')"; query='{"per_page":100}'; mode=pages
  elif [[ "$endpoint" =~ ^actions/runs/([0-9]+)/artifacts\?per_page=100$ ]]; then route=run_artifacts; params="$(jq -cn --argjson id "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{run_id:$id}')"; query='{"per_page":100}'; mode=pages
  elif [[ "$endpoint" =~ ^actions/runs/([0-9]+)$ ]]; then route=run; params="$(jq -cn --argjson id "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{run_id:$id}')"
  elif [[ "$endpoint" =~ ^git/ref/heads/(.+)$ ]]; then route=get_ref; params="$(jq -cn --arg branch "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{branch:$branch}')"
  else fail "no typed HTTP route for endpoint: $endpoint"; fi
  transport_call "$route" GET "$target" "$params" "$query" null "$mode" || return $?
  [[ "$LAST_REQUEST_STATUS" != 404 || "$allow_missing" == true ]] || return 1
  [[ -n "$LAST_REQUEST_STATUS" ]] || fail "missing measured status for route $route"
  jq -e . "$target" >/dev/null || fail "invalid JSON for route $route"
}

require_listed() {
  local want="$1"
  jq -e --argjson want "$want" '
    def subset($small; $big):
      if ($small | type) == "object"
      then ($big | type) == "object" and ($small | to_entries | all(. as $kv | $big[$kv.key] != null and subset($kv.value; $big[$kv.key])))
      else $small == $big end;
    .outward_actions.canary.actions
    | any(.[]; subset($want; .)
               and (($want.inputs == null) or ((.inputs // {}) | del(.matrix_evidence)) == ($want.inputs | del(.matrix_evidence))))' "$REVISION_FREEZE" >/dev/null \
    || fail "action is outside the approved canary section: $want"
}

api_post_create_ref() {
  branch="$1"; sha="$2"; target="$3"; body="$(jq -cn --arg ref "refs/heads/$branch" --arg sha "$sha" '{ref:$ref,sha:$sha}')"
  require_listed "$(jq -cn --arg ref "refs/heads/$branch" --arg sha "$sha" '{action:"create_ref",ref:$ref,sha:$sha}')"
  transport_call create_ref POST "$target" '{}' '{}' "$body" one
  [[ "$LAST_REQUEST_STATUS" == 201 ]] || fail "create-ref returned HTTP $LAST_REQUEST_STATUS"
}

api_post_dispatch() {
  inputs="$1"; branch="$(printf '%s' "$FIXTURE_REF" | sed 's#^refs/heads/##')"
  require_listed "$(jq -cn --arg ref "$branch" --argjson inputs "$inputs" '{action:"workflow_dispatch",ref:$ref,inputs:($inputs|del(.matrix_evidence))}')"
  body="$(jq -cn --arg ref "$branch" --argjson inputs "$inputs" '{ref:$ref,inputs:$inputs}')"
  # The dispatch route is typed by its workflow ID; an empty parameter object is refused before any request (253-101).
  transport_call dispatch POST /dev/null "$(jq -cn --argjson id "$WORKFLOW_ID" '{workflow_id:$id}')" '{}' "$body" one
  [[ "$LAST_REQUEST_STATUS" == 202 || "$LAST_REQUEST_STATUS" == 204 ]] || fail "dispatch returned HTTP $LAST_REQUEST_STATUS"
  [[ "$LAST_INPUT_KEY_COUNT" == "$(jq -r 'keys|length' <<<"$inputs")" ]] || fail 'transmitted dispatch input count differs from serializer'
  [[ "$LAST_INPUT_UNICODE_SCALARS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$LAST_INPUT_UTF8_BYTES" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$LAST_INPUT_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]] || fail 'transport did not retain exact dispatch input byte metrics'
  preserve_evidence
  jq --argjson inputs "$inputs" --argjson sequence "$LAST_REQUEST_SEQUENCE" \
    --argjson scalars "$LAST_INPUT_UNICODE_SCALARS" --argjson bytes "$LAST_INPUT_UTF8_BYTES" --arg digest "$LAST_INPUT_SHA256" \
    '.dispatch_inputs=$inputs | .dispatch_input_metrics += [{sequence:$sequence,key_count:($inputs|keys|length),unicode_scalars:$scalars,utf8_bytes:$bytes,sha256:$digest}]' \
    "$EVIDENCE" > "$EVIDENCE.tmp" && mv "$EVIDENCE.tmp" "$EVIDENCE"
  # Request-free discovery wait after the 2xx dispatch: GitHub makes the run listable only after a short delay, and the
  # caller then makes its single charged listing (253-101, commit E).
  sleep "$DISCOVERY_WAIT"
}

download_no_follow() {
  url="$1"; target="$2"
  if [[ "$url" =~ ^https://api.github.com/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/runs/([0-9]+)/logs$ ]]; then
    transport_call run_logs GET "$target" "$(jq -cn --argjson id "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{run_id:$id}')" '{}' null download
  elif [[ "$url" =~ ^https://api.github.com/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/artifacts/([0-9]+)/zip$ ]]; then
    transport_call artifact_zip GET "$target" "$(jq -cn --argjson id "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" '{artifact_id:$id}')" '{}' null download
  else fail 'download URL did not match an approved typed route'; fi
  [[ "$LAST_REQUEST_STATUS" == 200 ]]
}

store_preflight() {
  local source="$1" destination="$2" label="$3" prior_ref prior_sha prior_status
  if [[ -e "$destination" ]]; then
    preserve_path "$destination" "preflight-$label"
    prior_ref="$PRESERVED_REF"
    prior_sha="$PRESERVED_SHA"
    prior_status="$PRESERVED_STATUS"
    preserve_evidence
    jq --arg path "$destination" --arg ref "$prior_ref" --arg sha "$prior_sha" --arg status "$prior_status" \
      --arg evidence_ref "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_REF" --arg evidence_sha "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_SHA" --arg evidence_status "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_STATUS" \
      --arg evidence_path "${EVIDENCE#${ROOT}/}" \
      '.preserved_revisions += [{path:$path,ref:$ref,sha256:$sha,status:$status},{path:$evidence_path,ref:$evidence_ref,sha256:$evidence_sha,status:$evidence_status}]' \
      "$EVIDENCE" > "${EVIDENCE}.tmp" && mv "${EVIDENCE}.tmp" "$EVIDENCE"
  fi
  cp "$source" "$destination"
  cmp -s "$source" "$destination" || fail "fresh $label preflight did not read back exactly"
}

if [[ ! -e "$EVIDENCE" ]]; then

# Fresh read-only preflights share the immutable 117-new-request budget with all

fresh_preflight() {
RATE_RESPONSE="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/recovery-rate.XXXXXX")"
RULES_RESPONSE="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/recovery-rules.XXXXXX")"
WORKFLOW_RESPONSE="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/recovery-workflow.XXXXXX")"
LEGACY_RESPONSE="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/recovery-legacy-protection.XXXXXX")"
CHECK_RUNS_RESPONSE="$(mktemp "$WORK_DIR/recovery-check-runs.XXXXXX")"
# D-12 decision server-parent-identity: the candidate is created inside the window and no workflow runs on gsd/* refs,
# so native check sources come from the frozen server parent (identity only; success stays a PR-head rule).
[[ "$CHECK_SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]] || fail 'frozen server-parent check source is missing or malformed'
api_get rate_limit "$RATE_RESPONSE"
CORE_LEFT="$(jq -r '.resources.core.remaining // 0' "$RATE_RESPONSE")"
(( CORE_LEFT > 250 )) || fail "GitHub core API budget is at or below 250 (remaining=$CORE_LEFT)"
# Ruleset listings contain names and IDs, not the active rules for main.
api_get 'rules/branches/main?per_page=100' "$RULES_RESPONSE"
api_get 'branches/main/protection' "$LEGACY_RESPONSE" true
api_get "commits/$CHECK_SOURCE_SHA/check-runs?per_page=100" "$CHECK_RUNS_RESPONSE"
api_get "actions/workflows/$WORKFLOW_ID" "$WORKFLOW_RESPONSE"
jq -e 'type == "array" and length <= 200' "$RULES_RESPONSE" >/dev/null || fail 'effective branch rules exceed the two-page completeness ceiling'
jq -e '.id == 259268962 and .path == ".github/workflows/ci.yml" and .state == "active"' "$WORKFLOW_RESPONSE" >/dev/null || fail 'registered workflow identity differs from fresh GitHub response'
jq -e '[.[] | select(.type=="required_status_checks") | .parameters.required_status_checks[].context] | sort == (["Library tests","Example unit smoke (ExUnit + ConnTest)","Install smoke (fresh phx.new + sigra.install)","Example HTTP smoke (boot + curl critical routes)","Example Playwright smoke (full lifecycle)"] | sort)' "$RULES_RESPONSE" >/dev/null || fail 'fresh effective required-check names differ from the frozen five-name contract'
RULE_PAGE_COUNT="$(jq -r '[.transactions[] | select(.route_id=="rules_main")] | length' "$REQUEST_LEDGER")"
[[ "$RULE_PAGE_COUNT" == 1 || "$RULE_PAGE_COUNT" == 2 ]] || fail 'fresh effective rules do not have one or two measured pages'
RULE_LAST_COUNT="$(jq -r '[.transactions[] | select(.route_id=="rules_main")][-1].response_body_base64 // empty' "$REQUEST_LEDGER" | base64 -d | jq 'length')"
(( RULE_LAST_COUNT < 100 )) || fail 'last effective rules page is full; terminal completeness is unknown'
FIRST_RULE_COUNT="$(jq -r '[.transactions[] | select(.route_id=="rules_main")][0].response_body_base64 // empty' "$REQUEST_LEDGER" | base64 -d | jq 'length')"
if [[ "$FIRST_RULE_COUNT" == 100 ]]; then [[ "$RULE_PAGE_COUNT" == 2 ]] || fail 'full first effective rules page requires a charged second page'; fi
jq -e 'type=="object" and ((.required_status_checks // {})|type=="object")' "$LEGACY_RESPONSE" >/dev/null || fail 'legacy branch-protection response is malformed'
jq -e 'type=="object" and (.check_runs|type=="array")' "$CHECK_RUNS_RESPONSE" >/dev/null || fail 'native check-run source response is incomplete'
for check_name in "Library tests" "Example unit smoke (ExUnit + ConnTest)" "Install smoke (fresh phx.new + sigra.install)" "Example HTTP smoke (boot + curl critical routes)" "Example Playwright smoke (full lifecycle)"; do
  # 253-155 (R14): main lists each required name 2-3 times (R12 ledger sequence 21). Server-parent identity only: at least one
  # run, every run of the frozen commit with a complete app/source identity, and one app id+slug across the name's runs.
  jq -e --arg name "$check_name" --arg sha "$CHECK_SOURCE_SHA" '[.check_runs[] | select(.name==$name)] as $runs | ($runs | length >= 1) and ($runs | all(.head_sha==$sha and (.app.id|type=="number") and .app.id > 0 and (.app.slug|type=="string") and .app.slug != "" and (.html_url|type=="string") and (.html_url|startswith("https://")))) and ([$runs[] | [.app.id, .app.slug]] | unique | length == 1)' "$CHECK_RUNS_RESPONSE" >/dev/null \
    || fail "native check-run app/source identity is missing or duplicated: $check_name"
done
store_preflight "$RATE_RESPONSE" "$RATE_SOURCE" rate
store_preflight "$RULES_RESPONSE" "$RULES_SOURCE" rules
store_preflight "$WORKFLOW_RESPONSE" "$WORKFLOW_SOURCE" workflow
store_preflight "$LEGACY_RESPONSE" "$LEGACY_PROTECTION_SOURCE" legacy-protection
store_preflight "$CHECK_RUNS_RESPONSE" "$CHECK_RUNS_SOURCE" check-runs
preserve_evidence
jq --slurpfile rate "$RATE_RESPONSE" --slurpfile rules "$RULES_RESPONSE" --slurpfile workflow "$WORKFLOW_RESPONSE" \
  --slurpfile legacy "$LEGACY_RESPONSE" --slurpfile check_runs "$CHECK_RUNS_RESPONSE" \
  --arg ref "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_REF" --arg sha "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_SHA" --arg status "$PRIOR_EVIDENCE_STATUS" \
  --arg evidence_path "${EVIDENCE#${ROOT}/}" \
  '.preflight={initial_rate_limit:$rate[0],effective_rules:$rules[0],legacy_protection:$legacy[0],native_check_runs:$check_runs[0],registered_workflow:$workflow[0]} | .preserved_revisions += [{path:$evidence_path,ref:$ref,sha256:$sha,status:$status}]' \
  "$EVIDENCE" > "${EVIDENCE}.tmp" && mv "${EVIDENCE}.tmp" "$EVIDENCE"
record_budget
python3 "$ROOT/scripts/ci/ci-hosted-gate-verify.py" --mode preflight --evidence "$EVIDENCE" \
  || fail 'independent measured transport and effective check-source verification failed'
}

# 253-101 (commit C): the preflight runs once per evidence window. A later invocation on the same evidence holds an
# accepted preflight (a non-empty preflight object and one check_runs read in the window ledger), so it issues zero
# preflight-category requests and re-verifies the retained preflight offline instead.
# 253-155: the read may span pages (main's 209 runs, 100/100/9). The check_runs rows must form exactly one contiguous read:
# page_ordinal 1..n, every status 200, one commit, and n = ceil(total_count/100) from the page-1 body.
retained_preflight() {
  [[ -f "$EVIDENCE" && -f "$REQUEST_LEDGER" ]] || return 1
  jq -e '(.preflight | type == "object" and length > 0)' "$EVIDENCE" >/dev/null || return 1
  jq -e '[.transactions[] | select(.route_id == "check_runs")] as $rows | ($rows | length) as $n
    | $n >= 1
      and ([$rows[] | .page_ordinal] == [range(1; $n + 1)])
      and ($rows | all(.actual_status == 200))
      and ([$rows[] | ((.url // "") | [capture("/commits/(?<sha>[a-f0-9]{40})/check-runs[?]")] | .[0].sha)] | unique | length == 1 and .[0] != null)
      and (($rows[0].response_body_base64 // "" | @base64d | fromjson | .total_count) as $total
           | ($total | type == "number") and ([1, (($total + 99) / 100 | floor)] | max) == $n)' "$REQUEST_LEDGER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  [[ -f "$RATE_SOURCE" ]] || return 1
}
if retained_preflight; then
  python3 "$ROOT/scripts/ci/ci-hosted-gate-verify.py" --mode preflight --evidence "$EVIDENCE" >/dev/null \
    || fail 'the retained preflight failed offline re-verification'
  echo "ci-gate-canary: retained preflight re-verified offline (no preflight request)"
else
  fresh_preflight
fi
if [[ "$PREFLIGHT_ONLY" == true ]]; then

RATE_NOW="$RATE_SOURCE"

  preserve_evidence
